This repository is an Angular Conduit (RealWorld) single-page application. Application code lives under `src/`; the vendored `realworld` pack supplies conformance specs, API tests, and shared Playwright E2E. Local agent guides sit in code folders (see the component map). The harness INIT report is at [platform/init/INIT.md](platform/init/INIT.md). System behavior and data flow: [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md).

## Component map

| Component | Path | Responsibility | Local guide |
|-----------|------|----------------|-------------|
| `src` tree (SPA, assets, tests) | `src` | Top-level map for Angular sources, styles, and Vitest layout | [src/AGENTS.md](src/AGENTS.md) |
| Angular application | `src/app` | Routes, features, shell, Vitest unit tests, Conduit UI selectors | [src/app/AGENTS.md](src/app/AGENTS.md) |
| Core (auth, HTTP, layout) | `src/app/core` | JWT auth flow, interceptors, shell layout, shared models | [src/app/core/AGENTS.md](src/app/core/AGENTS.md) |
| Feature modules | `src/app/features` | Article, profile, settings modules and their services | [src/app/features/AGENTS.md](src/app/features/AGENTS.md) |
| RealWorld conformance pack | `realworld` | OpenAPI, Bruno/Hurl API tests, shared E2E, Starlight docs, theme assets | [realworld/AGENTS.md](realworld/AGENTS.md) |

Domain vocabulary and REST/UI contracts: [DOMAIN.md](DOMAIN.md), [CONTRACTS.md](CONTRACTS.md).

## Commands

Run from the repository root unless a skill or local `AGENTS.md` says otherwise. Status is **documented** (see [package.json](package.json), [playwright.config.ts](playwright.config.ts), [TESTING.md](TESTING.md), CI workflows).

| Purpose | Command | Status |
|---------|---------|--------|
| Install / prepare | `bun run setup` | documented |
| Dev server (SPA) | `bun run start` | documented |
| Production build | `bun run build` | documented |
| Unit tests (Vitest) | `bun run test` | documented |
| E2E (excludes `@security`) | `bun run test:e2e` | documented |
| E2E security only | `bun run test:e2e:security` | documented |
| Format check | `bun run format:check` | documented |

Focused Vitest paths, `TEST_MODE`, Bruno vs Hurl, and focused E2E: [TESTING.md](TESTING.md).

## Rules

Binding rules for agents (evidence paths, harness-only edits, command status, human guidance): [RULES.md](RULES.md). Recommended patterns: [GUIDELINES.md](GUIDELINES.md).

## Skills

Use local guides under `src/` and `realworld/` for scoped work. Root workflow for a single Playwright file: [skills/run-focused-e2e-spec/SKILL.md](skills/run-focused-e2e-spec/SKILL.md).

### `realworld/skills`

| Skill | When to use |
|-------|-------------|
| [realworld/skills/add-e2e-health-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-health-spec/SKILL.md) | Add or extend Playwright smoke checks that the Conduit SPA loads, core routes work, and optional public API reachability when `EXTERNAL_API` is on. |
| [realworld/skills/add-e2e-null-fields-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-null-fields-spec/SKILL.md) | Add E2E coverage for null API `image`/`bio` → `default-avatar.svg`, empty bio, and `/settings` form values. |
| [realworld/skills/add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec/SKILL.md) | Add Playwright cases for invalid `localStorage` `jwtToken`, reload, and unauthenticated UI (`BROWSER_API`). |
| [realworld/skills/add-e2e-auth-flow-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-auth-flow-spec/SKILL.md) | Add or extend Playwright authentication tests for register, login, logout, validation, and session behavior. |
| [realworld/skills/add-e2e-article-crud-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-article-crud-spec/SKILL.md) | Add or extend Playwright article tests for create, edit, delete, favorite, and author-only actions. |

### Root `skills`

| Skill | When to use |
|-------|-------------|
| [skills/run-focused-e2e-spec/SKILL.md](skills/run-focused-e2e-spec/SKILL.md) | Run one Playwright E2E spec file or narrow subset via the root package script without the full grep-filtered suite. |

Conformance pack workflows (Bruno, Hurl, pack E2E): [realworld/AGENTS.md](realworld/AGENTS.md). SPA structure and unit checks: [src/AGENTS.md](src/AGENTS.md).
